# Digivolve verification map

Use disposable repository guidance and synthetic conversations. Read the [shared driver and evidence contract](../../verification/README.md).

- [Preferences](preferences.md): default state, on, off, status, persistence, and conversation isolation. This is the offline baseline.
- [Manual reflection](manual-reflection.md): untrusted or empty-conversation skips, ordinary reflection, and force.
- [Adaptive reflection](adaptive-reflection.md): genuine correction, negative controls, single-flight behavior, cancellation, and transient results.

Live reflection needs an approved authenticated model and a synthetic trusted repository. The empty offline baseline deliberately lacks those preconditions and cannot prove reflection. Keep evidence after cleanup and label each skipped entry point. Creation-time runtime proof is blocked; all entries remain unverified until run.
